info.author: Sandbox
info.description: Clean self-oscillating Ladder LP24. Cutoff: Knob→Pitch Range→Pitch↔Hz→Frequency. Resonance: Knob→Graph→Ladder Resonance (no Range→Range, no external feedback loop). Noise exciter; raise Resonance toward 1 to self-oscillate.

volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Slider 0â€¦1 = full-scale bipolar wave. Min/max are guides only â€” type large values for gain past unity (domain not hard-clamped).

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

octave.tooltip: MIDI offset in octaves before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: MIDI offset in semitones before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Fine MIDI offset in cents before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Ignored when Out = Pitch Out.

Normalized index. Scales In only. 0 → Out is Bias. 1 → Out = Bias + In×Bias. DSP does not clamp; raise min/max for |index| > 1.

bias.tooltip: Carrier. Always added. Out = Bias + In × Bias × Amplitude. Amp 0 still outputs Bias.

layout.text:
Creates a variable shaped sinusoid using wavetable frequency feedback.

The AM Index equation: 

Out = Bias × (1 + In × Amplitude)
